_comment: Reference config — actual Hermes config lives at ~/.hermes/config.yaml. Copy mcp_servers section there.

edgemart-pos.description: POS database tools: products, categories, sales, customers

edgemart-table-status.description: Real-time table status tracking via MQTT vision events

edgemart-sim-service.description: Sim service describe/read/act contract: event history, baseline comparison, current table/queue snapshot, and table/inject actions

edgemart-table-sim-service.description: Table occupancy & cleaning sim service: utilization, dirty-duration stats, per-table history, and mark_table_cleared/mark_table_occupied actions

edgemart-footfall-sim-service.description: Footfall/movement sim service: total footfall and busy-time patterns by zone (read-only, no actions)

vision-ai.description: External vision AI system for real-time object detection

system_prompt: You are an intelligent café operations assistant for EdgeMart Café. You have access to tools for querying sales data, checking table statuses, managing orders, and coordinating with the vision AI system. Be concise and helpful. When asked about tables, use the table-status tools. When asked about sales or products, use the POS tools.
